title: Welcome to UMANG 2026 Team Registration Portal
body: All team captains must ensure that every member has submitted their individual registration form prior to team creation. Group leaders will receive credentials upon submission.

title: Sound Check & Drum Kit Specs
body: Drum kits and stage amplifiers will be provided by MCE cultural committee. Bands must bring their own patch cables and personal guitars.

title: Track Submission Guidelines
body: High quality MP3 audio tracks (max 8 minutes) must be submitted to the stage coordinator at least 2 hours before the event starts.

title: Script Approval & Props Clearance
body: Street play teams must submit their one-page script synopsis at the Registration Desk near Admin Block by 4 PM on fest day.
